aspect.skydeitymysticpivot.xun: Xun: yin below, two yang above, the image of Wind and Wood.
aspect.skydeitymysticpivot.kan: Kan: yang within, yin without, the image of Water.

tc.research_text.skydeitymysticpivot:GUA: One yin over two yang: the marsh
Where the stone stands, the trigram stands
tc.research_name.skydeitymysticpivot:TER: The Earthly Qi of the Eight Trigrams
bagua.page.intro: The eight trigrams sit above the aspects: Qian, Dui, Li, Zhen, Xun, Kan, Gen and Kun. Learn them to combine at the research table and to infuse; wand rods and caps are graded by them.
bagua.page.source_scan:
Three ways to learn a trigram:
· Scan: Qian=sunlight detector, Dui=golden apple, Li=firework rocket, Zhen=bell, Xun=note block, Kan=seagrass, Gen=blast furnace, Kun=hay block.
· Research table: combine its two aspects.
· Crucible: boil the item into the matching essentia.
bagua.page.source_fuse:
Research table: drag the two aspects into the rune circle and press the purple button.

Crucible: boil the item into the matching trigram essentia.
bagua.page.rule:
Trigram makeup:
Qian=Aer+Lux, Dui=Aqua+Metal, Li=Fire+Lux, Zhen=Aer+Weather, Xun=Aer+Tree, Kan=Aqua+Dark, Gen=Earth+Trap, Kun=Earth+Chaos.
bagua.page.terrain_all: Each trigram condenses in a certain terrain; the pedestal reads the terrain it stands on. Priority: Li > Kan > Gen > Xun > Dui > Zhen > Kun > Qian.
bagua.page.assembly: Wand assembly: 1 rod + 2 caps of the same kind, placed diagonally. Name = cap + rod. Stats: Xuanshu 2060 vis/60% cost; Sixiang 1949/80%; four beasts 918/80% each.
bagua.page.wand_assembly: In the arcane workbench, place the rod in the center and two matching caps in the top-right and bottom-left corners.
bagua.page.materials_b:
Xuanshu Crystal Cluster: a nether star at the centre, one of each beast ingot, 4 Xuanshu Shards, 4 Xuanshu Bagua Salt and 6 of each trigram, by infusion. Place them in symmetric pairs around the infusion matrix to calm instability.
Akashic Records: grants 1000 research points in every aspect.
Xuanshu Radiance: arcane worktable - two amethyst shards around a nitor, one Xuanshu Bagua Salt below, 30 of each primal, two per craft.
Teaching Scroll: completes every unfinished research.
item.skydeitymysticpivot.akashic_records: Grants 1,000 research points for every aspect
item.skydeitymysticpivot.focus_cosmos.lo: Use on a block: 10 of each primal aspect - the block itself becomes a drop
Use: 200 of each primal aspect - gain a warding qi, negate one death
Shift right-click: bind your current spot (position and dimension) into this wand.
Right-click: spend 10 of each of the six vis, and return to the bound spot.
item.skydeitymysticpivot.focus_chrono.lo: Right-click a machine: spend 25 of each primal aspect, and it runs at 16x speed for 32 seconds.
Hasten the same machine again to raise the rate: 16 -> 32 -> ... -> 256x cap.
bagua.page.caps: Route: Kan → Xuanshu ingot → xuanshu shard → cloth / rod / cap → wand. The three machines and charger are a separate line.
bagua.page.node_ingots: The four beast ingots (Azure Dragon, Vermilion Bird, White Tiger, Black Tortoise) are mid-tier materials, made only in the arcane workbench, 87 of each primal each.
tc.research_text.skydeitymysticpivot:SHA: All that is left of a beast
bagua.page.node_shards: Shards are the next tier after beast ingots. Beast shards come from their ingot in the crucible; xuanshu shards from a bagua shard. The infernal furnace turns beast ingots into bagua shards and xuanshu shards into salt. Bagua shards used to be furnace-only; now the crucible also trades one beast shard for one (4 of each trigram), while the furnace keeps its 2-per-ingot bulk road.
bagua.page.node_cloths: Sixiang cloth is silver-white, Xuanshu cloth black-gold; both are alchemically made and wrap the rod.
tc.research_text.skydeitymysticpivot:WAN: The rod holds, the cap spends
bagua.page.node_wands: The rod sets the wand's capacity. All six are made by infusion, then fitted with two matching caps.
bagua.page.node_caps: The cap sets the cost; lower is better. Rod in the center, two matching caps in the corners.

block.skydeitymysticpivot.bagua_stone.lo: Trigram stone. Wherever it stands, its qi attunes to the land of that chunk (%s is its nature).
bagua.page.stones_what: A trigram stone is a positional requirement for infusion: eight stones, one per trigram, placed under the base. A missing stone voids the recipe. Extra stones add 2 instability each, up to three.
bagua.page.stones_recipe: Make stones on the pedestal: form the altar on the right terrain, place essentia jars within 5×5, put a stone brick on top; after 8 points of the trigram it becomes the stone.
bagua.page.pedestal_altar: The pedestal does three things: reads the terrain's trigram; draws essentia from nearby jars; turns a stone brick into a trigram stone. On Qian terrain, obsidian slowly becomes crying obsidian.
bagua.page.pedestal_qi: Pedestal made in the arcane workbench; stone bricks made in the crucible, nine for a base. Draw range: 5×5 and two blocks vertically.
bagua.page.pedestal_lands: Terrain: Qian=open sky; Dui=swamp; Li=nether forests; Zhen=badlands; Xun=forest; Kan=warm ocean; Gen=mountains; Kun=Y<10 deep earth.
block.skydeitymysticpivot.xuanshu_crucib: Three chambers brew at once, drawing essentia from jars and tubes within 5x5x5.
block.skydeitymysticpivot.xuanshu_alchem: Automated essentia smelting: feed it items and it burns out their essentia by itself, then ships it to the tubes and jars around it.
bagua.page.machine_furnace: Three chambers smelt in parallel; one fuel drives all three; one batch per tick, up to 64. Feed top, draw bottom, six faces configurable. Special: beast ingot→2 bagua shards, xuanshu shard→2 salt; output doubled.
bagua.page.machine_crucible: Single-block crucible: no heat or water needed, three workfaces, one batch per tick. Draws essentia from 5×5×5.
bagua.page.machine_alchemy: Burns items into essentia: three chambers, one batch per tick, sends essentia to nearby pipes and jars. Six faces configurable (off / auto input).

tc.research_text.skydeitymysticpivot:PED: First an altar, then the trigrams
bagua.page.node_wands2: Rod choices: Xuanshu 2060/60% (hardest); Sixiang 1949/80% (hard); the four beasts 918/80% (easiest).
bagua.page.node_caps2: Cap choices: Cosmic (dragon egg, hardest); Kirin (nether star, hard); Vermilion Bird, Azure Dragon, White Tiger, Black Tortoise (easiest).
bagua.page.charger_intro: Place under an aura node and power with redstone: energizes the node in 10 seconds (drains up to 40 points); the cap keeps rising to 64/t; cutting redstone reverts it. Removing the charger after energizing makes the node explode.

block.skydeitymysticpivot.xuanshu_purify: Ring it 3x3 with one of each of the eight trigram stones, then right-click the centre with a wand: all nine take altar shape at once, and the range grows to the nine chunks around it.
block.skydeitymysticpivot.xuanshu_charge: Set directly below an aura node and power it with redstone: within ten seconds the node is energized.
Faster and cheaper than the vanilla three-block assembly - ten seconds, and at most forty points drawn from the node.
Once charged, the node's per-aspect caps keep rising over time (one step per second), lifting its per-tick output up to 64/t; cut the redstone and the node slowly reverts.

bagua.page.node_modifier: Adds an aspect to an aura node: place the node jar above, put a wisp essence and a xuanshu ingot in the UI, right-click with a wand. One aspect gains +12 per run. The gate is whether all six primals reached 256: below that, missing primals are filled first and then only primals grow; at 256 and above primals still lead, but compounds start growing too. The exact odds are on the 'Exact odds' page at the end of this entry.
bagua.recipe.xuanshu_node_modifier:
§l2. Requirements§r
Infusion (recipe on the previous page):
· centre: 1 Xuanshu Spirit Core
· eight cells: 1 xuanshu ingot, one of each beast ingot, 1 xuanshu shard, 2 primal mana, 1 Motus Ignis, 1 primal focus, 1 advanced node stabiliser, 1 essentia reservoir
· aspects: 32 of each trigram
· instability: 8
· stones: §9§lKan, Xun, Gen§r under the base.
bagua.page.node_modifier_lore:
§lExact odds§r
Each run first picks a stage, then an aspect within it (+12 to whatever is picked):
1. Any primal still at 0: 100% the first missing one (aer, terra, ignis, aqua, ordo, perditio).
2. All six present, some below 256: 20% new aspect / 80% primals (uniform among those below 256; 80/k% each when k are below).
3. All six at 256 or above: 20% new aspect / 48% primals (8% each) / 32% other existing compounds (32/N% each when N compounds are present).
A 'new' aspect is drawn uniformly from compounds the node does not have yet.
Example: with 16 compounds present, stage 3 is 20% new, 48% primals, 32% over those 16 (2% each).
bagua.gua.qian: Qian = Aer + Lux, the sky, gilded. Needed by: the three picks, the Cosmic cap, the Silverwood rod, the charger.
bagua.gua.dui: Dui = Aqua + Metal, the marsh, silver. Needed by: the three picks, the arcane table, the node modifier.
bagua.gua.li: Li = Fire + Lux, fire, vermilion. Needed by: Sixiang and Vermilion rods/caps, arcane table, node modifier.
bagua.gua.zhen: Zhen = Aer + Weather, thunder, green. Needed by: the purifying stone.
bagua.gua.xun: Xun = Aer + Tree, wind/wood, teal. Needed by: furnace, crucible, alchemy furnace, charger, spirit core, arcane table, node modifier.
bagua.gua.kan: Kan = Aqua + Dark, water, indigo. Needed by: spirit core, arcane table, node modifier, charger, three picks.
bagua.gua.gen: Gen = Earth + Trap, mountain, brown. Needed by: Sixiang and Vermilion rods/caps, four focuses, purifying stone, spirit core, arcane table, node modifier.
bagua.gua.kun: Kun = Earth + Chaos, earth, yellow. Needed by: Sixiang rod/cap, purifying stone.

§lII · Requirements§r
Infusion (diagram on the previous page):
· Center: 1 Clock
· Ring: 2 redstone, 2 quicksilver, 1 nether star, 2 Xuanshu Radiance, 1 Bagua Shard
· Aspects: 32 of each trigram
· Instability: 6
· Trigram stones: §9§lone of each of the eight§r - Qian, Dui, Li, Zhen, Xun, Kan, Gen, Kun all eight, or nothing happens.
bagua.page.focus_chrono_gate:
Eight stones anchor the altar: in the 5x5 layer under the central pedestal, lay one stone of each trigram - Qian, Dui, Li, Zhen, Xun, Kan, Gen and Kun. It counts kinds, not blocks; stacking the same stone does nothing. Miss one and the infusion will not start, and the action bar names the missing ones.
Every extra stone calms 2 instability, up to three of them.
